title: Property hint MultilineText not working properly for arrays of string in C#
body: ### Tested versions Reproducible in every official stable mono version that i have tested (From 4.0 to 4.6.2) ### System information Godot v4.6.2.stable.mono - Fedora Linux 43 (Workstation Edition) on Wayland - X11 display driver, Multi-window, 2 monitors - Vulkan (Forward+) - dedicated NVIDIA GeForce RTX 3060 Ti (nvidia; 580.142) - AMD Ryzen 5 5600X 6-Core Processor (12 threads) - 15.53 GiB memory ### Issue description When exporting string arrays in C# to the editor using the propertyhint PropertyHint.MultilineText the editor doesn't actually treats it as a array of multiline strings, like GDScript does. C# Expected ( GDScript ) Since Godot 4.2+, we can use _ValidateProperty in C# to override the export behavior, but it's more of a workaround and it requires adding running the script in [Tool] mode. ``` public override void _ValidateProperty(Godot.Collections.Dictionary property) { if (property["name"].AsStringName() == PropertyName.multiline) { property["hint_string"] = $"{Variant.Type.String:D}/{PropertyHint.MultilineText:D}:"; } } ``` ### Steps to reproduce Open the MRP and look at the nodes in the tree. Multiline has a C# script that exports a Godot.Collections.Array variable with no _ValidateProperty method overriden ValidateMultiline has a C# Script running in tool mode that exports a Godot.Collections.Array variable with _ValidateProperty overriden MultilineGDScript has a GDScript that exports a typed Array[string] variable ### Minimal reproduction project (MRP) [multiline_csharp_issue.zip](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/27161314/multiline_csharp_issue.zip)
